## The problem

What is hard or missing today.

## The change you want

What you would like to happen.

## Fit with the project

This project shows verbatim Bhagavad-gītā As It Is text and adds no language
model. Please note how your idea fits that boundary (see the README "What it
does" section and the verbatim-scripture and no-language-model rules in
`CLAUDE.md`).

## Success criteria it touches

Which criteria in `docs/SUCCESS-CRITERIA.md` your idea would add to or change
(for example, a new M-row, or an existing C-row). Leave blank if unsure.

## Evidence or examples

A sketch, a screenshot, a link, or a description of the behavior you have in
mind. Please do not paste any personal terminal content.

## Alternatives

Anything else you considered.
